text: The film opens with a robot battle, city establishing shots, and Thom and Celia on the bridge.
The resistance team gives its mission briefing as the plan to alter the past takes shape.
Thom returns through the city while the team prepares for the dangerous operation.
War memories reveal the earlier conflict and the history behind the machine threat.
The scientists prepare the memory simulation that can project the bridge scene into the past.
The team carries out the bridge and bunker operation while the resistance fights to survive.
The final robot battle unfolds through the bunker and cathedral as the team races to stop the machines.
The memory overwrite succeeds, and Thom reaches a fragile reconciliation after the battle.
Closing credits roll as the Tears of Steel film concludes.
